steps: Excess pressure in a soap bubble is given by P = 4T/R.
End 1 has a hemispherical bubble of radius r, so P1 = 4T/r.
End 2 has a sub-hemispherical bubble, meaning its radius of curvature R2 > r.
Excess pressure at end 2 is P2 = 4T/R2.
Air flows from higher pressure to lower pressure, so air flows from end 1 to end 2, decreasing the volume of bubble 1.
